messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: OTC omeprazole should be taken for only 14 days in a row. It may take 1 to 4 days before your symptoms improve. Allow at least 4 months to pass before you start a new 14-day course of treatment.
Call your doctor if your symptoms do not improve, or if they get worse.
Some conditions are treated with a combination of omeprazole and antibiotics. Use all medications as directed.
This medicine can affect the results of certain medical tests. Tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine.
Store at room temperature away from moisture and heat.
Triplet: ["Omeprazole", "has interaction with", "medical tests"]

The relation 'has interaction with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication may affect the results of the specified medical test or diagnostic procedure.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has test interference effect': The subject drug may cause a false positive or false negative result in the specified diagnostic test.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
